sentence: Trim the huge overgrown shrub next to the house.

observation.model_notes: Photo 2 shows a different property scene (front yard, driveway, porch shrubs, flowering tree) and does not show the shrub referenced in the request — its foundation shrubs are small and tidy, not overgrown, so no trimming line was created for it. The privacy fence in Photo 1 has no visible gate or access point in frame, so crew access to the shrub's enclosure (side/back area) is unconfirmed. Photo 1 shows some cut conifer branches already piled near a trash bin, suggesting a prior partial trim attempt — worth confirming with the customer whether that debris needs hauling too.

service_lines.uncertain: The shrub has several vertical stems rising from a shared base against the fence — could be one multi-stem shrub or several plants grown together; counted as one per the customer's singular description ('the huge overgrown shrub').

counting_evidence.note: Tall columnar conifer shrub with shaggy, untrimmed foliage rising well above the ~6ft wood fence it grows against, next to the house roofline visible in the background.

evidence.note: Shrub foliage is dense and overgrown along its full height with no visible recent shaping; a stub/cut stem near the base and a pile of cut conifer branches near the trash bin suggest a prior partial trim.
